method: For each threshold, p_adaptive = w*p30 + (1-w)*p90; w = clamp(0.25 + 4*abs(p30-p90), 0.25, 0.80). All probabilities are based only on observations before the target day.
interpretation: Exploratory, pre-declared regime-sensitive blend. It does not materially beat rolling-30 overall on 60- or 120-minute outcomes; a very small improvement appears for 180 minutes. This does not establish that strategy change caused the regime shift. No attack-weapon predictors are included.
caveats: Historical snapshot ends 2026-10-19 and is not live.
30-day baseline remains best on the aggregate common test period; adaptive blend is not a replacement recommendation yet.
The 180-minute threshold has few events; small Brier differences are unstable.
A separate historical attack dataset with publication timestamps is needed to test whether weapon mix/daytime-wave features add predictive value without leakage.
